blocks.en: Weak Solutions
blocks.zh: 弱解
blocks.label: sec:conservation-weak-solutions

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: As we observed in the previous section, smooth solutions of hyperbolic conservation laws can blow up (develop discontinuities or singularities) in finite time. But this is not simply a mathematical oddity. It was observed in the nineteenth century that there were types of physical wave motion that were essentially discontinuous in nature, and which were not predicted by linear wave equations. In such a case one could not follow the practice of accepting the solution of a differential equation even when the equation itself failed to make sense (as we were able to do in the case of D'Alembert's solution of the wave equation) because closed form solutions of the nonlinear problems could not be computed. In order to understand (and compute) discontinuous solutions, one needed to extend the notion of solution itself.
blocks.zh: 如上一节所见, 双曲守恒律的光滑解可在有限时间内爆破 (产生间断或奇性). 但这并非仅仅是数学上的奇特现象. 早在十九世纪, 人们就观察到某些物理波动本质上是不连续的, 线性波动方程无法预言这些现象. 在这种情形下, 不能沿用即使微分方程本身已无意义仍接受其解的做法 (在波动方程的 D'Alembert 解中曾可这样做), 因为非线性问题的闭式解无法算出. 为了理解 (并计算) 不连续解, 需要推广解本身的概念.

blocks.en: We begin our study of weak solutions by noting that the definition is indeed an extension of the classical notion of solution.
blocks.zh: 首先指出, 这一定义确实是经典解概念的推广, 由此开始对弱解的研究.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Suppose $\bm{u}\in C^1(\mathbb{R}^{2+})$ is a classical solution of \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system}, \eqref{eq:conservation-law-cauchy-data}. Then $\bm{u}$ is also a weak solution.
blocks.zh: 假设 $\bm{u}\in C^1(\mathbb{R}^{2+})$ 是 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system}, \eqref{eq:conservation-law-cauchy-data} 的经典解. 那么 $\bm{u}$ 也是弱解.
blocks.label: thm:classical-conservation-solutions-weak

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
The proof is a simple application of Green\textquotesingle s theorem in the plane. Take any $\bm{\phi}\in C_0^1(\mathbb{R}^{2+})$ and let $r$ be large enough so that $\operatorname{supp}\bm{\phi}\subseteq S$ where $S=B_r((0,0))\cap\mathbb{R}^{2+}$. Note that since $\bm{u}$ satisfies \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system} classically we have
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conservation-classical-product-identity}
(\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi})_t+(\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi})_x=\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x.
\end{equation}
Thus, using this with Green\textquotesingle s theorem and our information about the support of $\bm{\phi}$ we have
\[
\begin{aligned}
&\int\!\!\int_{\mathbb{R}^{2+}}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=\int\!\!\int_S(\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi})_t+(\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi})_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=-\int_{\partial S}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}x-\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=-\int_{-\infty}^\infty\bm{u}(x,0)\cdot\bm{\phi}(x,0)\,\mathrm{d}x\\
&=-\int_{-\infty}^\infty\bm{u}_0(x)\cdot\bm{\phi}(x,0)\,\mathrm{d}x.
\end{aligned}
\]
Here the next to the last equality was obtained from the fact that $\bm{\phi}=0$ on the half circle $t=(r^2-x^2)^{1/2}$. The final equation derived from the fact that $\bm{u}$ satisfies the initial condition \eqref{eq:conservation-law-cauchy-data}.
blocks.zh:
证明只是平面上 Green 定理的一个简单应用. 任取 $\bm{\phi}\in C_0^1(\mathbb{R}^{2+})$, 并将 $r$ 取得足够大, 使 $\operatorname{supp}\bm{\phi}\subseteq S$, 其中 $S=B_r((0,0))\cap\mathbb{R}^{2+}$. 注意, 由于 $\bm{u}$ 在经典意义下满足 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system}, 有
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conservation-classical-product-identity}
(\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi})_t+(\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi})_x=\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x.
\end{equation}
因此, 结合 Green 定理及关于 $\bm{\phi}$ 支集的信息, 得到
\[
\begin{aligned}
&\int\!\!\int_{\mathbb{R}^{2+}}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=\int\!\!\int_S(\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi})_t+(\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi})_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=-\int_{\partial S}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}x-\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=-\int_{-\infty}^\infty\bm{u}(x,0)\cdot\bm{\phi}(x,0)\,\mathrm{d}x\\
&=-\int_{-\infty}^\infty\bm{u}_0(x)\cdot\bm{\phi}(x,0)\,\mathrm{d}x.
\end{aligned}
\]
这里倒数第二个等式源于在半圆 $t=(r^2-x^2)^{1/2}$ 上 $\bm{\phi}=0$. 最后一个等式源于 $\bm{u}$ 满足初始条件 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-cauchy-data}.

blocks.en: The Rankine-Hugoniot Condition
blocks.zh: Rankine-Hugoniot 条件
blocks.label: subsec:rankine-hugoniot-condition

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Now that we have defined a weak solution, let us find necessary conditions for a discontinuous weak solution.

The following necessary condition \eqref{eq:rankine-hugoniot-jump-condition} on piecewise smooth weak solutions is known as the Rankine-Hugoniot condition.
blocks.zh:
既然已定义弱解, 现在来寻找不连续弱解的必要条件.

以下分片光滑弱解的必要条件 \eqref{eq:rankine-hugoniot-jump-condition} 称为 Rankine-Hugoniot 条件.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: thm:rankine-hugoniot

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Let $\bm{\phi}\in C_0^1(\mathbb{R}^{2+})$ be any test function with support in $N$. Since $\bm{u}$ is a weak solution we can write
\[
\begin{aligned}
0&=\int_N\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=\int_{N^r}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t
+\int_{N^l}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t.
\end{aligned}
\]
We now use Green\textquotesingle s theorem in the plane, the fact that $\bm{\phi}=0$ outside of a compact set contained in $N$ and the fact that $\bm{u}$ is a classical solution of \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system} in $N^r$ and $N^l$ to get the following:
\[
\begin{aligned}
0&=\int_{N^r}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t
+\int_{N^l}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=-\int_{N^r}(\bm{u}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})_x)\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t
-\int_C\bm{\phi}\cdot(-\bm{u}^r\,\mathrm{d}x+\bm{f}(\bm{u}^r)\,\mathrm{d}t)\\
&\quad-\int_{N^l}(\bm{u}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})_x)\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t
+\int_C\bm{\phi}\cdot(-\bm{u}^l\,\mathrm{d}x+\bm{f}(\bm{u}^l)\,\mathrm{d}t)\\
&=-\int_\alpha^\beta(-[\bm{u}]\hat x'+[\bm{f}(\bm{u})])\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}t.
\end{aligned}
\]
Since $\bm{\phi}$ was an arbitrary test function we can conclude that the Rankine-Hugoniot condition \eqref{eq:rankine-hugoniot-jump-condition} holds for every point $\bm{p}\in C$.
blocks.zh:
令 $\bm{\phi}\in C_0^1(\mathbb{R}^{2+})$ 为任意支集位于 $N$ 中的检验函数. 由于 $\bm{u}$ 是弱解, 可写为
\[
\begin{aligned}
0&=\int_N\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=\int_{N^r}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t
+\int_{N^l}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t.
\end{aligned}
\]
现在利用平面上的 Green 定理, 以及 $\bm{\phi}=0$ 在包含于 $N$ 的某个紧集之外成立和 $\bm{u}$ 在 $N^r$ 与 $N^l$ 中为 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system} 的经典解这些事实, 得到:
\[
\begin{aligned}
0&=\int_{N^r}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t
+\int_{N^l}\bm{u}\cdot\bm{\phi}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})\cdot\bm{\phi}_x\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=-\int_{N^r}(\bm{u}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})_x)\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t
-\int_C\bm{\phi}\cdot(-\bm{u}^r\,\mathrm{d}x+\bm{f}(\bm{u}^r)\,\mathrm{d}t)\\
&\quad-\int_{N^l}(\bm{u}_t+\bm{f}(\bm{u})_x)\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}t
+\int_C\bm{\phi}\cdot(-\bm{u}^l\,\mathrm{d}x+\bm{f}(\bm{u}^l)\,\mathrm{d}t)\\
&=-\int_\alpha^\beta(-[\bm{u}]\hat x'+[\bm{f}(\bm{u})])\cdot\bm{\phi}\,\mathrm{d}t.
\end{aligned}
\]
由于 $\bm{\phi}$ 是任意检验函数, 可以得出 Rankine-Hugoniot 条件 \eqref{eq:rankine-hugoniot-jump-condition} 对每个点 $\bm{p}\in C$ 都成立.

blocks.en: The Lax Shock Condition
blocks.zh: Lax 激波条件
blocks.label: subsec:lax-shock-condition

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Such a huge multiplicity of solutions is unacceptable. The physics associated with conservation laws, particularly with the example of gas dynamics, leads one to expect a unique solution. Thus, we need a "selection criterion" that picks out the physically reasonable solution from among the many possible weak solutions.
blocks.zh: 如此大量的解的多重性是无法接受的. 与守恒律相关的物理, 尤其是气体动力学这个例子, 使人期待解是唯一的. 因而需要一个"选择准则", 从许多可能的弱解中选出物理上合理的解.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A number of such criteria have been proposed, but there is as yet no general agreement on which is the "right" one. Roughly speaking, all of the conditions agree for certain "easy" types of conservation laws, but there are pathological cases for which they disagree. Unfortunately (or fortunately if you plan to be doing research in this area) some of the pathological cases occur in important physical problems (such as oil recovery models), so the question of the best selection criterion is not simply mathematical sophistry.
blocks.zh: 已有多种这样的准则被提出, 但哪一种才是"正确的", 迄今尚无普遍共识. 粗略地说, 对某些"简单"类型的守恒律, 所有条件都一致, 但在一些病态情形下它们并不一致. 不幸的是 (如果打算在这一领域从事研究, 也可以说是幸运的), 某些病态情形出现在重要的物理问题中 (例如石油开采模型), 所以最佳选择准则的问题并非仅仅是数学上的诡辩.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The criterion we present in this section is one of the most widely used, primarily because it is rather easy to implement in the Riemann problems discussed below. It was introduced by Peter Lax in the 1950s~\cite{La}. We will examine some of the Lax condition\textquotesingle s competitors in Section~\ref{sec:entropy-selection-criteria}.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍的准则是使用最广泛的准则之一, 主要因为它在下文讨论的 Riemann 问题中相当容易实施. Peter Lax 在二十世纪五十年代提出了这一准则~\cite{La}. 将在 Section~\ref{sec:entropy-selection-criteria} 中考察一些与 Lax 条件竞争的准则.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: def:lax-shock-condition

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
For Burgers' equation the Lax shock condition \eqref{eq:lax-shock-condition} reduces to
\begin{equation}\label{eq:burgers-lax-condition}
u^l>s>u^r,
\end{equation}
so that we can only "jump down" across a shock. This rules out the discontinuous weak solution described in Figure~\ref{fig:burgers-two-weak-solutions} in which the characteristics leave the discontinuity. More generally, for a single conservation law
\[
u_t+f(u)_x=0,
\]
we have
\begin{equation}\label{eq:scalar-lax-condition}
f'(u^l)>s>f'(u^r).
\end{equation}
Thus, as was the case in Burgers\textquotesingle\ equation, Lax\textquotesingle s criterion requires characteristics to impinge on a shock for any single conservation law. This is often described as a "loss of information," and, as we shall see, the Lax condition is related to a version of the second law of thermodynamics.

The reader should also note the relation between convexity and the Lax shock condition for single conservation laws (cf. Problem~\ref{ex:convexity-lax-scalar-shock}).
blocks.zh:
对 Burgers 方程, Lax 激波条件 \eqref{eq:lax-shock-condition} 化为
\begin{equation}\label{eq:burgers-lax-condition}
u^l>s>u^r,
\end{equation}
所以只能跨激波"向下跳跃". 这就排除了 Figure~\ref{fig:burgers-two-weak-solutions} 中所描述的特征线离开间断处的不连续弱解. 更一般地, 对单个守恒律
\[
u_t+f(u)_x=0,
\]
有
\begin{equation}\label{eq:scalar-lax-condition}
f'(u^l)>s>f'(u^r).
\end{equation}
因此, 与 Burgers 方程的情形一样, 对任意单个守恒律, Lax 准则要求特征线汇入激波. 这常被描述为"信息损失", 而且如后文将看到的, Lax 条件与热力学第二定律的某个版本有关.

读者还应注意单个守恒律的凸性与 Lax 激波条件之间的关系 (参见 Problem~\ref{ex:convexity-lax-scalar-shock}).
